name: OpenTTD
description: Private OpenTTD server with persistent worlds and TCP multiplayer.

PORT.description: Private readiness HTTP port; no public HTTP domain.

SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Generated game password; share only with invited players (16–32 ASCII letters, digits, _ or -).

SERVER_NAME.description: Game name (1–60 ASCII letters, digits, spaces, ., _, or -).

MAX_CLIENTS.description: Maximum simultaneous players, from 2 to 64. Invalid values use 16.

SAVE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Checkpoint interval in real seconds, from 10 to 3600. Invalid values use 60.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow checkpoint saving before stopping the game on redeploy.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAP_SECONDS.description: Keep exactly one process using the persistent world.
